title: Malaysian MotoGP
metaDescription: Malaysian MotoGP: verified dates, location and OneSliders event context for Motogp.

overview.about: The Malaysian Grand Prix is held at the Sepang International Circuit near Kuala Lumpur, a wide, modern track known for its long straights, hard braking and sweltering tropical heat and humidity. Frequent afternoon downpours add another layer of challenge and often reshuffle the order. The 2026 race is on 30 October - 1 November.
overview.nextEvent: The 2026 Malaysian Grand Prix runs 30 October - 1 November at Sepang. The wide layout encourages overtaking, but the tropical heat and sudden monsoon rain make tyre and energy management decisive.
